g.text: Received census events referenced by RP diagnostics, by immediate input identifiers
Cells: RP-referenced / received census event count; coverage sums original 1/n_received_events_case weights before division.
Columns name immediate actual / preview input. Parent weights precede all identifier/loss-mode selection. Raw counts and weighted coverage differ.
NA = no events in this cell; 0% = observed events but none referenced. No new AUC, rollout or causal selection claim.
